test_web_search_tool: test the web_search_tool to search Exa API and return normalized JSON results with title, url, and snippet fields
test_web_fetch_tool: test the web_fetch_tool to fetch Exa page content and return formatted markdown with title and text
test_search_with_custom_config: test web_search_tool respects custom configuration values like max_results, search_type, and contents_max_characters
test_search_error_handling: test web_search_tool returns error string on API exception instead of raising
test_fetch_truncates_long_content: test web_fetch_tool truncates page content to 4096 characters in returned markdown
